headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential security risks and vulnerabilities in npm/PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansions. Leverage machine learning models from DeepInfer for enhanced accuracy and speed.
actions: Integrate DeepInfer's machine learning algorithms to predict and mitigate risks associated with package installations.
Implement a real-time scanning feature that checks dependencies against known vulnerabilities databases like Snyk or npm Audit.
Develop a user-friendly interface that highlights potential issues, suggesting safer alternatives for problematic packages.
